The '''Gerres Gule system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Primtara sector/Legends|Primtara sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gerres Gule]].
